csv_project_name: Design Build for Washington Dulles Revitalization Package A
csv_scope_of_work: The Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority may be seeking a consultant to provide Design Build for Washington Dulles Revitalization Package A.The Airports Authority is requesting qualifications from Design-Builders (Progressive Design-Build preferred) for comprehensive design and construction services related to the Washington Dulles Revitalization (WDR) Package A at Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD). The scope of work covers comprehensive cradle to grave services, including planning, design, pre-construction, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, tenant relocations and closeout for multiple interconnected projects within Package A, to be completed by 2034.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Transportation Planning
csv_comments: '- Project Number: RFQI-26-24445- Project Funding: Federal- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 07/01/2026 03:00 PM EDT - 3 Firms may be shortlisted
title: Design-Build for Washington Dulles Revitalization Package A
short_description: Major airport revitalization package with integrated design, construction, commissioning, and tenant relocation services.
project_location: Washington Dulles International Airport, Sterling, Virginia, USA
project_scope: Comprehensive Washington Dulles Revitalization Package A at Washington Dulles International Airport, comprising multiple interconnected projects to be delivered by 2034. The scope includes cradle-to-grave services: planning, design, pre-construction, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, tenant relocations, and closeout. The procurement seeks design-builders, preferably under a progressive design-build model, for a large airport infrastructure package.
services: Progressive design-build preferred; comprehensive design and construction services including planning, design, pre-construction, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, tenant relocations, and closeout. Disciplines requested include design-build/developer, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Very large and strategically important infrastructure project with early design involvement through design-build.
- However, the notice is focused on a broad airport revitalization package rather than a clearly defined bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structural package.
- Requested disciplines emphasize general design-build, MEP, planning, and transportation planning more than structural engineering.
- Could contain complex structural components, but no specific spans, roof structures, terminals, or signature structures are described.
- Relevant mainly as a potential team/joint-venture opportunity, but only moderately aligned with sbp's core profile based on the available information.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: total construction cost stated as $4.5B-$5.0B; midpoint used.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice describes a large progressive design-build procurement for a $4.5B-$5.0B airport revitalization package through 2034, but it does not identify a separate structural engineering fee or planning fee share for sbp-relevant services.
references_qualifications: Qualifications are requested from design-builders, with progressive design-build preferred. Three firms may be shortlisted. No detailed minimum reference counts or specific structural reference requirements are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority, Sterling, VA, USA. Contact: Marissa Arco. Phone: 703-417-8672. Fax: 703-417-8993. Email: marissa.arco@mwaa.com. Website: https://www.mwaa.com/business/current-contracting-opportunities
notes: Project number RFQI-26-24445. Federal funding. Questions deadline: 07/01/2026 03:00 PM EDT. Source indicates solicitation documents are available online. The package likely includes multiple building and infrastructure components, but no specific terminal areas, gross floor areas, or structural characteristics are provided.
